q: Gaboriau's l²-Betti numbers are invariants of measure equivalence classes of groups. His theorem (2002) showed:
opts: All groups have the same l²-Betti numbers
Free groups Fₙ and Fₘ are not measure equivalent for n ≠ m (their l²-Betti numbers differ)
Amenable groups have non-zero l²-Betti numbers
l²-Betti numbers are orbit equivalence invariants
exp: Gaboriau proved that l²-Betti numbers are measure equivalence invariants. Since βₙ(Fₙ) = n−1, free groups Fₙ and Fₘ are not measure equivalent when n ≠ m, solving a long-standing open problem.
